evidence.observation: o2_exhaust not_installed; growth stage requires the exhaust O2 sensor to verify the atmosphere
Brief 10.8 °C overshoot at the start of growth, then held at 750.0–750.2 °C
Steady at about 760 Torr throughout, with no sign of a leak or blockage
Tracking the 100 sccm setpoint within about 1.5 sccm
Steady at about 46% during growth, in line with the ramp

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or another independent check of the atmosphere, is needed to confirm the growth atmosphere has no oxygen. Characterization of the sample is also needed.
